verdicts.reason: The summary mentions Paris only as context and never states the 2 °C/1.5 °C goals or the non-binding, sanction-free commitments.
It says that according to Saito these attempts "no cuestionan el sistema económico dominante" and that the Green New Deal and Fit for 55 rely on decoupling growth from emissions.
The summary mentions reliance on decoupling but not that it might take about 100 years, too late for the 10-20 year window.
It says these policies "externalizan costes ambientales a países en desarrollo".
It calls for alternatives such as "el decrecimiento" and says the transition is "no es una cuestión técnica sino una disputa sobre qué tipo de sociedad queremos sostener".
